name: Jam
description: Jam's MCP is the fast lane between Jam recordings and your dev tools. Drop a Jam link into VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude and the whole recording – video, console, network, logs – arrives pre-packaged. No hand-typing repro steps, no copy-paste stack traces, no screen-share drama. Your tools get instant context, you stay in flow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jam.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jam provides these MCP tools: getDetails, getConsoleLogs, getNetworkRequests, getScreenshot, getUserEvents, and analyzeVideo.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jam in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Jam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jam is developed by Jam. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
